analytical_question: On all 24 frozen scan37 confirmation patches, how do the primary multiscale consensus candidate and its RMS-matched constant-damping control change local MAE and coverage relative to identity?
takeaway: The primary candidate has a small mean MAE reduction with a small recall loss; it does not improve mean MAE over the matched-displacement control.
variant: Paired per-patch delta dot plots plus all-method mean MAE/recall scatter and explicitly labelled detail view
renderer: Matplotlib static vector PDF/SVG with PNG review export
scatter_grain: One point per method; equal-weight mean of all 24 patches
selection: All confirmation rows with strict validation of expected complete case-method cross product; numeric case order; no post-hoc exclusion
reference: identity for both per-patch delta panels

metrics.accuracy_mm: Mean nearest-neighbour output-to-reference distance over a fixed input-derived local observed mask; lower is better
metrics.recall_pct: 100 times the fraction of fixed local reference points within 1 mm of any output point; higher is better
metrics.delta_recall_pp: 100 times method recall minus identity recall, in percentage points
metrics.aggregate: Unweighted arithmetic mean of 24 per-patch metrics, never pooled point weighting

non_color_encoding: Filled blue circles for primary; open orange squares for matched; hollow grey circles/diamonds for context; a solid zero benchmark and paired grey connectors
font: Times New Roman; vector PDF Type 42 font embedding; SVG editable text
qa: Recompute means and comparisons from stored rows; assert match to SUMMARY.json; inspect exported PNG; record source hash and exact derived values
limitations: One confirmation scene, sampled local patches, not a full-scene DTU score
No error bars or significance claim because patch-level variability is not an independent cross-scene replication
The all-method scatter has a separate labelled detail panel; no hidden axis break
This rendering reuses stored metrics and does not rerun geometric experiments
